generation_guards: Show exactly one flamingo, exactly six cows, and exactly seven penguins.
Bind the brown color attribute only to the single flamingo.
Keep all animals fully visible and separated so each individual can be counted.
Avoid extra flamingos, cows, penguins, or other animals.
Avoid crowding, overlap, partial cropping, or hidden bodies.
initial_plan.generation_strategy: Use a clear wide composition with three separated groups: one brown flamingo in its own space, six cows grouped separately, and seven penguins grouped separately. Arrange individuals in rows with small gaps to support accurate counting and prevent occlusion.
initial_plan.initial_prompt: A clear wide scene showing exactly one brown flamingo, exactly six cows, and exactly seven penguins. Place the single brown flamingo alone on the left, fully visible. Place the six cows in the center as six distinct, fully visible cows, separated with small gaps and not overlapping. Place the seven penguins on the right as seven distinct, fully visible penguins, separated with small gaps and not overlapping. Ensure accurate counts: 1 brown flamingo, 6 cows, 7 penguins. No extra animals, no hidden animals, no cropped animals, no occlusion.
